_README: TEMPLATE for local label extensions. Copy to concepts.local.json and edit.
The .local.json is gitignored and never leaves your machine.
concepts.py ships GENERIC defaults - the labels a mailbox actually accumulates are
personal, and belong here rather than compiled into the program. Add a label under
the concept it means, so a query for that concept reaches ALL of it. That is the
whole point: labels drift until many of them stand for one concept, and a query on
the obvious label then answers with a fraction of the truth, stated as the whole.
Extend-only by design. You may add labels to a shipped concept, and you may name a
new concept. You cannot remove a shipped one - so a typo here degrades to an
UNMAPPED label, which is visible, rather than silently unmapping labels that used
to resolve. An absent file is the normal case, not an error.
Shipped concepts you can extend: social / platform notifications, marketing / promo,
money (bills, receipts, banking), account & security, newsletters, medical,
family & people, open questions / candidates, steam, mail logistics, calendar, other.
_concept_keys: Optional. Short URL-safe keys for any NEW concept you named above, so the UI never
has to pass a long concept name through a query string.
